body_en: Time management is part of responsibility. Put phone away when you promised to study. Finish what you start, even if the task feels boring. Lead by example in group projects: arrive on time, bring your part ready. People trust those who deliver.
body_zh: 时间管理也是责任。答应学习时就把手机放下。哪怕无聊也要做完。小组作业以身作则：准时到、带好自己的部分。能交付的人更被信任。

exam_grounded.label: 做人与做事
